To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Chinese universities have been administratively controlled and administratively managed, and that the Chinese universities are not independent in their academic activities.

the essence of administrativenes in Chinese universities is the administrational power of university being considered as part of the administrational power in government, which weakens the university autonomy and puts the academic and scientific power on the verge, furthering the tendency of academic deviation and academic corruption.

the cultural background of administrativeness of Chinese universities is that Chinese traditional culture and the party culture have been affected by society centered concept and the design of officer and teacher,collectivism and unit system,which have led to the administrativeness of universities and furthered the tendency that academic autonomy and academic power are on the verge.
